name: SnapshotField - Copy Confirmed
description: The state a resting capture cannot show: the button flipped to its confirmed form for ~1.6s after the click. The console error is the POINT — the capture browser blocks the Clipboard API by permissions policy, which is exactly the rejection this component swallows. The confirmation is deliberately unconditional, so in a hardened profile or a non-secure context where the copy silently failed, the user still sees this and can fall back to selecting the text themselves rather than meeting a page error on the one recovery path this feature points them at.
